description: Source code for the SqlPreferenceStore class, managing user preferences in a Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, cleanup, and feature toggles.

classes.name: SqlPreferenceStore
classes.description: Implements preference storage operations for Mattermost, including CRUD, cleanup, and feature toggle management.

methods.name: newSqlPreferenceStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlPreferenceStore with a query builder for preferences.

methods.name: deleteUnusedFeatures
methods.description: Deletes unused feature toggle preferences marked as false.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a batch of preferences within a transaction, ensuring atomicity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts or updates a single preference within a transaction.

methods.name: saveTx
methods.description: Inserts or updates a preference within a provided transaction.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific preference by user ID, category, and name.

methods.name: GetCategoryAndName
methods.description: Retrieves preferences matching a specific category and name.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Retrieves preferences for a specific user and category.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Deletes all preferences for a specific user permanently.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific preference by user ID, category, and name.

methods.name: DeleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes all preferences for a user within a specific category.

methods.name: DeleteCategoryAndName
methods.description: Deletes preferences matching a specific category and name.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedRows
methods.description: Removes preferences linked to non-existent posts.

methods.name: CleanupFlagsBatch
methods.description: Deletes flagged post preferences with no associated posts, up to a limit.

methods.name: DeleteInvalidVisibleDmsGms
methods.description: Removes preferences for DMs/GMs visibility where values are outside valid range.
